details.message:
Hi Yale AI Club,

Thanks for reaching out about 20 navy hoodies in size M. We currently have 8 available. We can discuss an order for up to those 8, but we can’t confirm the full 20 right now: replenishment is blocked while an outstanding supplier invoice is unpaid, and the additional 12 units would require more funding. We also can’t confirm a bulk-discounted price yet; the $58 list price is the current reference, not a quoted discounted offer. Would you prefer to discuss the 8 currently available, or wait while we work through replenishment? No order has been placed.

Best,
Campus Customs

details.outcome: Request for 20 size M navy hoodies cannot be confirmed: current availability is 8, supplier replenishment is blocked by overdue invoice #501, and available funds after obligations are insufficient for the reported 12-unit gap. Discount terms remain unconfirmed; $58 is list price only. Unsent draft offers discussing up to 8 available units or deferring while constraints are addressed. No order or purchase was placed.

details.note: Internal follow-up on the paid reprint invoice. Lead-time estimate only; vendor confirmation, quantity, shipment, and physical receipt remain pending. Inventory is unchanged.

details.message: Hi Tauhid, the size S Bulldog tee is currently out of stock. The reprint invoice has been paid and the supplier is unblocked. This is only an estimate—the supplier has not confirmed quantity or shipment, and our on-hand stock remains zero until the items physically arrive. We’ll update you when we have confirmation.
